Types → shield, composite, cinder

Hazards → lava, ash, lahars

items: Remember the three volcano types: shield, composite, and cinder.
Note the full eruption spectrum ranging from Hawaiian to Plinian.
Distinguish volcanic hazards (lava, ash, lahars) from benefits (fertile soil, geothermal).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Volcanoes involve the eruption of magma.
The primary types of volcanoes are shield, composite, and cinder.
Eruption scale spans from Hawaiian to Plinian types.
Major hazards associated with eruptions are lava, ash, and lahars.
Volcanoes offer positive benefits including fertile soil and geothermal energy.
